worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = private pension (person 0) 25,000.00 = 25,000.00. Form PIT-1, single. Line 9 federal AGI 25,000.00. Line 10 0.00 (standard deduction taken). Line 11 additions 0.00. Line 12 federal standard deduction 15,750.00. Line 13 dependents 0.00. Line 14 low- and middle-income worksheet: line 1 25,000.00; line 2 20,000.00; line 3 5,000.00; line 4 0.15; line 5 750.00; line 6 2,500.00 - 750.00 = 1,750.00; line 7 1 exemption(s); line 8 = 1,750.00. Line 15 PIT-ADJ deductions and exemptions 0.00. Line 17 = 25,000.00 + 0.00 - 15,750.00 - 1,750.00 - 0.00 = 7,500.00. By the projection: state_agi = federal taxable income 9,250.00 = 9,250.00; less base deductions 1,750.00 gives 7,500.00. Line 18 tax, schedule as numbers: 1.5% x 5,500.00 = 82.5 + 3.2% x 2,000.00 = 64; total 146.5, to the cent 146.50. The table row over 7,400 to 7,500 gives 145; expected keeps the formula figure. Lines 19 to 21 0.00. Line 22 net New Mexico income tax 146.50. Born 1961-01-02 is 64 at the end of 2025: no exemption.
